verdict.rationale: A tax-agency e-services portal could plausibly offer recurring scheduled actions, such as recurring payments or scheduled filings, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only one-off actions (file a return, make a payment, submit documents) and email notifications, with no recurring schedule or scheduled workflow capability. One-off actions do not substitute for a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
